intent: Style query: some Coen brothers comedies welcome, but mostly other dark, deadpan comedies about hapless people and botched crimes.

items.title: The Man Who Wasn't There
items.essence_text: A neo-noir crime drama with striking black and white cinematography and a pervasive sense of melancholy. Set in 1949, the film follows a barber entangled in a web of crime and deceit. The slow-burn narrative emphasizes atmosphere, moral ambiguity, and psychological depth, creating an intriguing and thought-provoking experience. The Coen Brothers' signature style and dark humor are evident in the film's quirky characters and unexpected twists.
